utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring the screwdriver set, zip ties, and a flashlight. Oren said he’ll watch for my message and help where he can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — and Sam’s helping with the repair drive too, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, Sam’s helping too. We should be set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot—if Gus can lend the tools and help get the missing ones there on time, and Rey can keep the drop-off list updated, I can make the rest of the logistics work.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and connect anyone who needs a fix with Ira. If anyone’s got extra tools or can help later today, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thank you — I’ll keep the drop-off list tight and make sure the tools are lined up on time. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll bring the sign-up sheet over and walk Bo through the first few sign-ups. Opal can head to the community center parking lot by the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got a few volunteers lined up, and I’ll bring the spare tools I have for the repair drive. Dane can catch up and pitch in where needed, and Faye’s checking the school calendar and helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll have the sheet ready, and we can get everyone signed up quickly when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did Hana confirm the repair drive date yet? Nell and I are still sorting the flyers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Not yet, I don’t think. I’m keeping an eye out for Leo’s message and I’ll jump in where I can with the donations or carrying stuff.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. If Hana gets back to you, let me know — Nell and I will keep sorting the flyers.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve been mentioning the repair drive to folks I run into today. If you know anyone who still needs a fix, send them my way—I’m trying to line up a few more people.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll stop by later and see who still needs a fix. If you’re short on any tools or supplies, let me know and I’ll ask around.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik—I appreciate it. I’m still lining up a few more folks, so I’ll let you know if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Tess, thanks for checking in. Oren’s helping sort donations and carry a few things, and Ira’s been spreading the word while out on errands today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great—Gus can bring a few tools to help too. Between everyone pitching in, this repair drive’s really coming together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of Gus to offer. I’m grateful—every little bit helps, and it’s starting to feel manageable.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve been asking around—do you know who’s organizing the repair drive? Mina and I are sorting the flyers by street, so I can help with that too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Vik’s keeping it simple and will pass along the time and place once it’s set. We still need a few volunteers and some basic tools, so I’m just waiting on the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep sorting the flyers by street and can help hand them out too. If you hear what tools are needed, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can take the first few tasks. Rosa can bring the sign-up sheet by and walk me through the first sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the missing tools and make sure they get there on time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Gus — that’ll help a lot. Rosa can bring the sheet by and I’ll handle the first few sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the repair drive date and let Mina know once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Hana. I can spread the word, and Mara said she’ll round up a few volunteers and bring her spare tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks, Dane. I’ll confirm the date first and then let Mina know right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on the repair-drive supplies, and I can help gather what we still need. Sam’s bringing over the screws, duct tape, and any tools folks can lend soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’s great — I’ve got the drop-off spot noted as the community center parking lot by the side entrance. I’m keeping track of who’s coming, too, so I’ll add Sam to the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks, Opal. I’ll keep watching the supply list, and once Noah tells me what’s still missing, I’ll help round it up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive, and I’ll check the school calendar so we don’t clash with anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye. I’ll check what the repair drive is still missing and let Cleo know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll check the school calendar and share the repair drive details once I see what’s open.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep sharing the repair drive and let Opal know who’s coming. Thanks again for helping spread the word, Dane!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll gather the spare screws, duct tape, and any hand tools folks can lend, then bring everything over soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Sam—those supplies will really help. I’ll keep people posted and make sure Opal has your name on the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on the supplies, and I can help gather what we need for the repair drive. Once Noah lets me know what’s missing, I’ll make sure we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great, Cleo — and Gus said he can bring a few tools to help out too. Once Noah tells us what’s still missing, we’ll be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll watch for Noah’s list and pull together whatever’s still needed. Sam’s bringing the gathered supplies soon, so we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still asking around while I’m out running errands—trying to line up a few more folks for the repair drive. If you hear of anyone who needs a fix, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’m keeping track of names, and I’ll head to the community center parking lot by the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Opal — that helps a lot. I’ll keep asking around and send anyone your way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still sorting the flyers for the repair drive — can you check the date with Hana and let me know?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — I’ll ask Hana about the date and let you know. I can also sort tools or hand out flyers if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — please ask Hana and let me know the date when you can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the tools and take a volunteer shift for the repair drive. I can also sort the deliveries and keep the drop-off list updated.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a huge help, Rey. I can bring the tools and help get any missing ones there on time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that really helps. I’ll sort the deliveries and keep the drop-off list updated.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks again for helping spread the word about the repair drive, Dane. I’m getting everything set up, and Opal’s keeping track of who’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course. I’ve been mentioning it when I’m out, and I can help sort donations too if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That would be amazing, Uli—thank you! I’ll let Opal know you can help sort donations too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive, and I’ll also check the school calendar so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye. Once you’ve got the time and place set, please let me know so I can plan for it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll check the school calendar and get back to you with the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for Leo’s message and help where I can. I can sort donations or carry a few things if that’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — that’d be a big help. I’m gathering screws, duct tape, and any hand tools folks can lend, and I’ll bring what I collect over soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect — I’ll watch for Leo’s details and be ready to sort or carry whatever you need. Just let me know when the stuff comes over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the repair drive date carefully and let Mina know once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana. Once you confirm the date, could you also let Gus and Rey know so the tools and deliveries can be lined up on time?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — once the repair drive date is confirmed, I’ll let Gus and Rey know too so everything can be lined up on time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help spread the word for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Dane — that’d help a lot. Rosa’s got the sign-up sheet ready and she’ll bring it by to walk me through the first few.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll make sure folks know about it. Just point me to the right place when Rosa drops by.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll check what the repair drive is still missing and let Cleo know. Then maybe Nell can ask around and see who’s organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds great — I’ll keep spreading the word and point anyone with a fix to Ira. If you hear what tools or supplies they’re short on, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do — I’ll look into what tools or supplies are still needed and pass it along to you and Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got a few volunteers lined up and I’ll bring my spare tools to the repair drive. Dane said he’ll catch up and help wherever needed, and Faye’s checking the school calendar and spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring the screwdriver set, zip ties, and a flashlight. Oren’s watching for my message and will help where he can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s perfect, Leo — we’ve got a solid crew and the basics covered. I’ll keep rounding up folks and make sure my tools are ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Sam’s helping with the repair drive, right? Just wanted to make sure I heard that correctly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that’s right — Sam’s helping with the repair drive. I’ll bring the sign-up sheet over and walk Bo through the first few sign-ups, too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it, thanks for confirming. I just wanted to make sure I had that right.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
